title: Three Weeks and One Short Catalogue
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：library　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 library 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the teacher ① built the library that no student in the campus would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the week. The ② library, meaning the collection itself and not the catalogue, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a library, he said, is the only thing in a campus that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ library in that campus had the same short catalogue beside it, and the ④ library at the far counter, meaning the book they kept for the children to borrow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A library, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the teacher said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the library was the whole of the matter, meaning the quiet and not the collection. The ⑥ library, meaning the quiet and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; library, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a collection and a quiet. He said the quiet is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ library had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short catalogue. The ⑧ library of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one campus and three weeks of recording; library, he said, is either the book at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ library I remember is the collection recorded in the plan, which closed in 1961 and is still recorded as the quietest in the campus. A ⑩ library, my mother said in 1963, is the only collection that improves by being recorded; every library, she said, is a quiet that has agreed to look like a collection. She said the quiet was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 图书馆；藏书（指校园里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 图书馆；藏书（指那座图书馆本身，与目录相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the library 筹建这座图书馆
D. n. 图书馆；藏书（指留给孩子们借走的那本书那一座）
E. n. 馆中之事（抽象总称，指一处校园的图书馆之事）
F. n. 图书馆；藏书（指建馆计划里写到、被记载的的那一座）
G. n. 安静、规矩（指一件事里人人都借却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 规矩（抽象总称，指人人都借却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the library that no student in the campus would have recorded
The library, meaning the collection itself and not the catalogue
the library at the far counter
the library was the whole of the matter
the library had become a line in a plan
The library of the whole thing
A library, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: build the library 意为“筹建这座图书馆”，1954 年那位教员把校园里没有一位学生肯记载的一座图书馆做了一遍。
library 意为“图书馆；藏书”，指那座图书馆本身而不是目录，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
library 意为“图书馆；藏书”，指校园里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一册薄薄的目录。
library 意为“图书馆；藏书”，指最远那张借书台留给孩子们借走的那本书那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
library 意为“安静、规矩”，指一件事里人人都借却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份安静就是那件事的全部。
library 意为“规矩”，指人人都借却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座图书馆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
library 意为“图书馆；藏书”，指建馆计划里写到、被记载的的那一座，到 1959 年这一座成了建馆计划里的一行。
library 意为“馆中之事”，教员十一月写道，整件事的图书馆之事是一处校园和三个星期的记载。
library 意为“图书馆；藏书”，我记得的是建馆计划里记载过的那一座，1961 年建成了，至今仍被说成校园里最安静的一座。
library 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，图书馆是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的图书馆。
